scope: Application-owned UI and storage flows; external destination requests are aborted in this suite.

checks: new game popups preserve exact direct/proxy destinations including the SVG; only Dancing Bunny receives the verified launcher hint
Newgrounds has a targeted streamlined popup; empty Picks opens, traps focus, returns with Escape and contains no invented cards
saved Newgrounds children have a nonintrusive manager and complete private recovery download; other sites retain normal mirror management
draft preview stays isolated; unsafe/duplicate/disabled cards are excluded, media fails gracefully, and cards offer direct/proxy launches with failure feedback
real globe/document SVGs retain bounded dimensions through expanded/collapsed, moved category and section management views
section restoration previews accepted ordering, focuses Cancel, cancels without writes and preserves all personal data and unrelated layout when confirmed
global confirmation and cancellation preserve hidden states, moved built-ins, custom bookmarks, notes, mirrors and catalog decisions
a real localStorage write failure leaves the exact previous collection intact and offers useful recovery feedback
tablet and narrow phone empty-state layouts fit without overflow; return/close controls work with emulated touch
rapid Picks/Restore close and reopen keeps one dialog/title identity, current focus and normal body scrolling with default and reduced motion
Settings bookmark management exposes both scoped and global confirmation, with cancellation and useful restored focus
